info.name: Sanad — Yemen Bank (Test)
info.description:
Bank-facing API collection for Yemen Bank, the test client on the Sanad identity verification platform.

**Environment variables** (set these in the collection variables tab or in a Postman environment):
- `baseUrl` — `https://sanad-api.promatrix.ai`
- `clientId` — Yemen Bank's client ID
- `clientSecret` — Yemen Bank's client secret (shown only once at issue time)

Authentication uses HTTP Basic (client_id:client_secret). Postman's Basic Auth on the collection handles this automatically — no need to build the header manually.

request.description:
Verify a Yemeni citizen by their national ID number.

**Request:**
- `nationalNumber` (required, max 32 chars) — the citizen's 10-digit national ID.
- `biometrics` (optional) — for biometric match against a captured fingerprint.

**Response fields returned** depend on the subscription plan:
- `YEMEN_ID_BASIC` — hit-only (verification status + biometric score, no demographics)
- `YEMEN_ID_PREMIUM` — full demographics, cards, biometric match (Yemen Bank's current plan)

response.name: 200 · Success (Premium plan)

request.description:
Same endpoint with an optional biometric image for a fingerprint match.

- `fingerPosition` — 1–10 (right-thumb = 1, left-little = 10 per ICAO convention)
- `image` — base64-encoded fingerprint (PNG/WSQ). Max 32,000 chars.
Demonstrates the 400 response shape for validation errors.
Basic liveness probe. Returns `{"status":"UP"}` when the platform is healthy.
